plan.title: Responses View by Vendor and Product

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ with two bids directly on its Responses tab.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration for the case.
Verify the Responses view shows the first bidding vendor's real name.
Verify the Responses view shows the second bidding vendor's real name.
Verify the first vendor's bid value is rendered in the Responses grid.
Verify the second vendor's bid value is rendered in the Responses grid.
Confirm the initial vendor-oriented Responses grid rendered without errors or raw values.
Switch the Responses grid to the product-oriented view.
Confirm the product-view control is visible after switching views.
Verify the first vendor's price remains visible in product-oriented view.
Verify the second vendor's price remains visible in product-oriented view.
Confirm the product-oriented Responses grid rendered without errors or raw values.
Switch the Responses grid back from product-oriented view.
Confirm the view toggle back to the vendor-oriented display leaves the screen clean.
